title: Digital Marketing Intern
description: Company DescriptionHike Advertising is a creative marketing and web development agency based in Calicut, Kerala. We help businesses build a strong and professional digital presence through social media management, paid advertising, website development, AI-generated videos, branded content, and custom software solutions. Our team combines creativity, technology, and strategic thinking to deliver effective digital experiences that help brands connect with their audience, improve visibility, and support business growth. We work with startups, local businesses, healthcare brands, and growing companies across Kerala and the UAE, providing reliable marketing and technology solutions tailored to their goals.Role DescriptionWe are looking for a Digital Marketing Intern to support social media management, content creation, paid campaigns, and performance tracking.The role also requires basic video editing and image editing skills for creating reels, social media posts, promotional videos, and ad creatives.This is a full-time internship with the option to work either on-site at our Calicut office or remotely.QualificationsBasic knowledge of Digital Marketing and Social Media Marketing.Understanding of Meta Ads, Google Ads, and content marketing.Video editing and image editing skills are required.Good communication, creativity, and time-management skills.Ability to learn quickly and work effectively with a team.Preferred QualificationsFamiliarity with Canva, CapCut, Photoshop, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.Basic knowledge of social media insights and campaign performance metrics.Experience creating reels, social media creatives, or promotional content.Degree, diploma, or certification in Digital Marketing, Marketing, Communications, Business, Multimedia, or a related field.
